tools.name: king_county_address_to_parcel
tools.description: Convert a King County, WA street address to its 10-digit parcel number — county-namespaced (king:/pierce:), with the permitting jurisdiction derived from the city-limits polygon (not the mailing city), match quality (point / interpolated / street, snapped house number), and parcel-polygon fallback where the locator has no address point. Verifies bare PINs. Read-only.
